qualification.note: Queued-zero wake filtering has no stable4-worker gain; bounded spin worsens Windows4/8-worker throughput and CPU, so neither was adopted. WSL spin variant intentionally not run after Windows rejection. Mutex tracing adds timers/bookkeeping while the acquired lock is held; only deterministic lock counts are causal resource evidence, not trace throughput/wait-time percentages. Windows whole-fixture CPU uses coarse GetProcessTimes quantization and is not a precise service CPU baseline. Formal first matched ready-array profiles preserve complete validation and shared callback atomics. Submission width is an explicit differing fact, not a forced same-workload regression comparison. Historical scalar driver/reports remain unchanged; no claim that arbitrary scalar callbacks now scale linearly. Original five repeats/one warmup/MAD3%/central6% and5%/10% settings remain; failed gates/raw samples retained. WSL/unpinned components do not establish native production/fixed-arrival/72h acceptance.
